summary: Genco Shipping & Trading filed an 8-K disclosing a Fourth Amendment to its October 1, 2025 shareholder rights plan, extending the Final Expiration Date to September 30, 2027 following the June 18, 2026 advisory vote. The amendment shortens the Qualifying Offer minimum-price measurement window from 24 to 12 months, converts Board and special-meeting timelines from 90 business to 90 calendar days, and lets an offeror withdraw if a Material Adverse Effect occurs. No price, stake, or premium is stated. Watch whether the extended pill deters or invites a control bid.
